body.content: Candidate 1 (vacuous discharge) is a deliberate foil: it agrees on 48 but argues the even-constraint does no work. This is criticizable because 138 mod 6 = 0 only guarantees divisibility by 2 and 3 jointly; it does not fix the residue class of the smallest term. The even-constraint still rules out (45,46,47). So the 'does no work' claim is likely false — the constraint eliminates at least one rival triple.
body.why_keep_this: Documents a criticizable candidate's weakest point for later rebuttal.
